dedupe_keys.name: a co simulation framework for autonomous mobility in urban mixed traffic context

description: The source establishes an implemented co-simulation joining SUMO traffic dynamics through TraCI with a corresponding three-dimensional Unity road map. A large Bari area includes intersections, traffic lights and pedestrian zones. Experiments vary vehicle numbers and types to estimate autonomous-vehicle speeds on route alternatives and find minimum-travel-time paths. The source defines an urban digital twin for simulation; live sensor synchronisation, packaged source access and public operation are unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: A Co-Simulation Framework for Autonomous Mobility in Urban Mixed Traffic Context
